{{Quote|That's a turadium shield alloy. It's going take forever to cut through it.|Princess Leia on a Turadium alloy blast door|<ref name="FotJV" />}}
'''Turadium''' was a type of [[metal]] that could be alloyed.<ref name="FotJV" />

==Characteristics==
Turadium was exceptionally strong, and was used in the massive two-meter thick [[Blast door/Legends|blast doors]] of the [[New Jedi Temple]]'s Operations Hangar. Turadium could be mixed with durasteel to make turadium shield alloy, which was used in the security hatches of the [[New Jedi Temple]]'s detention center. While not immune to [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], Turadium was very difficult to cut through, taking an exceptional amount of time.<ref name="FotJV" />
